obs = observe()
cands = grasp_candidates("blue_pen")
# Grasp candidate with valid squeeze width / fits open fingers
valid_cands = [c for c in cands if c.get("fits_open_fingers", True)]
cand = max(valid_cands, key=lambda c: c.get("score", 0)) if valid_cands else cands[0]

res = grasp(cand)
if not res["holding_something"]:
    # Fallback to candidate closest to center
    cand = min(cands, key=lambda c: (c["x"] - obs["objects"]["blue_pen"]["center"][0])**2 + (c["y"] - obs["objects"]["blue_pen"]["center"][1])**2)
    grasp(cand)

obs = observe()
zone = obs["zones"]["magenta_holder"]
zx, zy, _ = zone["center"]
rim_h = zone.get("rim_height", 0.08)

# Carry directly above the holder rim
carry_to(zx, zy, height=rim_h + 0.08)

# Release pen directly into the holder opening from above rim
open_gripper()
retreat(dz=0.15)
go_home()
check("blue_pen", "magenta_holder")

obs = observe()
# The blue_pen was classified or placed lying horizontally on magenta_holder / blue_mug

# "blue_mug": {"kind": "mug", "center": [0.0041, -0.076, 0.846], "top_z": 0.892, "height": 0.092, "footprint_long": 0.138, "footprint_short": 0.015...}
# Notice blue_pen is lying across the holder rim (detected as object or we need to grasp it).

cands = grasp_candidates(obj_key)
# Grasp candidate near an end to let it tilt/stand or grasp near one end
cand = cands[0]
for c in cands:
    if c.get("fits_open_fingers", True):
        cand = c
        break

# Pick candidate or offset grip point towards one end along long axis
cand_to_use = dict(cand)
# If grasping the object lying across rim, let's grasp near the end
# Or use skills.place_on_zone_v1 orientation logic
grasp(cand_to_use)

obs = observe()
zone = obs["zones"]["magenta_holder"]
hx, hy, _ = zone["center"]
rim_h = zone.get("rim_height", 0.092)
table_z = obs["table_z"]

# Carry above holder
carry_to(hx, hy, height=rim_h + 0.18)

# Reorient gripper so held pen (along side vector) points vertically downwards
# side = approach x finger_axis. To make side = [0, 0, -1] (or [0, 0, 1]):
# approach horizontal, e.g. [1, 0, 0], finger_axis horizontal, e.g. [0, 1, 0] -> side = [0, 0, 1]
# If side is along z, the pen is oriented vertically!
z_target = table_z + rim_h + 0.12
orientations = [
    ([1, 0, 0], [0, 1, 0]),
    ([0, 1, 0], [-1, 0, 0]),
    ([-1, 0, 0], [0, -1, 0]),
    ([0, -1, 0], [1, 0, 0]),
]
for app, f_ax in orientations:
    ik = solve_ik(hx, hy, z_target, approach=app, finger_axis=f_ax)
    if ik["reachable"]:
        move_gripper(hx, hy, z_target, approach=app, finger_axis=f_ax, path="joint")
        break

# Lower into holder
move_by(dz=-0.06)
open_gripper()
retreat(dz=0.15)
go_home()
check("blue_pen", "magenta_holder")
